title: Agents on ComfyUI: tools, verification, side-effect safety
hook: The model proposes, plain code checks, and limits live outside the model. Before, gate, and after.

verified.claim: The error names come from validate_inputs and validate_prompt.
The agent host loads an optional package and leaves its trust boundary to that package.
All tables come from this lesson's lab, against a stub.
A wire to a missing node and an output slot that doesn't exist both report exception_during_inner_validation, and an unknown node stops at missing_node_type.

unchecked: We did not read the comfy-agent package or run any agent.
How often a model invents nodes isn't measured here; 'often' is our experience, not a count.
The gate is our policy, not a ComfyUI feature.
